description: Connector that provides an HTTP client for consuming any REST service

0d06f1c3-ede6-498a-9ca6-e0ac0f1c9213.name: GET
0d06f1c3-ede6-498a-9ca6-e0ac0f1c9213.description: Invokes the HTTP GET method to get data from a specific resource.

inputs.name: restUrl
inputs.description: URL of the REST endpoint including protocol, host and path. E.g. 'http://www.alfresco.com'

inputs.name: restUrlParams
requestPayload
inputs.description: JSON body of the HTTP request

inputs.name: requestHeaders
circuitBreaker
inputs.description: If this variable is present and true with any value, the circuit breaker is enabled.

inputs.name: timeout
inputs.description: Integer with the timeout call in milliseconds. E.g: 910000. Default timeout is 30000 milliseconds.

inputs.name: restUrlEncoded
inputs.description: Indicates whether the final URL should be encoded or not

inputs.name: responseContentTransformations
inputs.description: Array of configurations for extracting and decoding content from the REST response. The decoded content is stored in the content repository and the encoded string in restResult is replaced with a content reference containing only sys_id (content identifier) and sys_path (file path).

path.description: JSON Pointer path to the encoded content in the response (e.g., /data/file or /data/files/0). Use an empty string to treat the entire response as Base64 content. In this case, only one entry can be processed.

decodeMethod.description: The method used to decode the content. Currently only BASE64 is supported.

filename.description: Optional filename for the decoded file. Defaults to file-{uuid}.bin if not specified.

outputs.name: restResult
outputs.description: The response from the REST service call

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Regular expression that the relative path of the URL shall match in order to trigger the action

inputs.name: method
inputs.description: HTTP methods that can trigger an action

inputs.name: condition
inputs.description: Expression that shall be true in order to trigger an action. Event and payload can be used in variables.

inputs.name: status
inputs.description: Status code to be returned to the service

inputs.name: headers
inputs.description: HTTP headers that shall match in order to trigger an action

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Request params that shall match in order to trigger an action

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: JSON Body to be returned to the external service. It can contain JUEL expressions that can be resolved using the event output as context metadata

inputs.name: requestContentTransformations
inputs.description: Array of configurations for extracting and decoding content from the webhook request body. The decoded content is stored in the content repository and the encoded string in the body output is replaced with a content reference containing only sys_id (content identifier) and sys_path (file path).

path.description: JSON Pointer path to the encoded content in the request body (e.g., /data/file or /data/files/0).

decodeMethod.description: The method used to decode the content. Currently only BASE64 is supported.

filename.description: Optional filename for the decoded file. Defaults to file-{uuid}.bin if not specified.

outputs.name: path
outputs.description: Relative path of the request URL

outputs.name: params
outputs.description: Query string or form params of the request

errors.name: MISSING_INPUT
errors.description: A mandatory input variable was not provided

errors.name: INVALID_INPUT
errors.description: The input variable has an invalid type

errors.name: UNKNOWN_ERROR
errors.description: Unexpected runtime error

errors.name: BAD_REQUEST
errors.description: The server could not understand the request due to invalid syntax

errors.name: UNAUTHORIZED
errors.description: The request has not been applied because it lacks valid authentication

errors.name: FORBIDDEN
errors.description: The server understood the request but refuses to authorize it

errors.name: NOT_FOUND
errors.description: The server could not find what was requested

errors.name: METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED
errors.description: The request method is known by the server but is not supported

errors.name: NOT_ACCEPTABLE
errors.description: The server cannot produce a response matching the list of acceptable values

errors.name: PROXY_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
errors.description: The request has not been applied because it lacks valid authentication

errors.name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT
errors.description: The server would like to shut down this unused connection

errors.name: CONFLICT
errors.description: The request conflicts with current state of the server

errors.name: GONE
errors.description: No longer available

errors.name: INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
errors.description: The server has encountered a situation it doesn't know how to handle

errors.name: NOT_IMPLEMENTED
errors.description: The request method is not supported by the server and cannot be handled

errors.name: BAD_GATEWAY
errors.description: The server got an invalid response

errors.name: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
errors.description: The server is not ready to handle the request

errors.name: GATEWAY_TIMEOUT
errors.description: The server is acting as a gateway and cannot get a response in time

errors.name: INVALID_AUTHENTICATION_TYPE
errors.description: The authentication type is invalid

errors.name: INVALID_CREDENTIALS_TOKEN
errors.description: The credentials are invalid

errors.name: INVALID_AUTHENTICATION_DATA
errors.description: The authentication data is invalid

errors.name: INVALID_BASE64
errors.description: The Base64 content in the response is invalid or cannot be decoded. Only thrown for text/plain responses.

errors.name: FILE_TOO_LARGE
errors.description: The decoded file size exceeds the maximum allowed limit

errors.name: STORAGE_ERROR
errors.description: Failed to store the decoded content in the content repository
